title: Jailbreak Quality Degrades with Model Scale? Testing Whether Smaller Models Produce More Actionable Harmful Content When Jailbroken

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Important risk assessment question: if larger models produce more dangerous content when jailbroken, this changes threat modeling fundamentally. Clear link from results to policy and deployment decisions.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires running Llama-3-70B which needs significant GPU resources (RunPod). GCG suffix transfer and StrongReject evaluation are technically involved. Beginners would struggle with the cross-model transfer pipeline.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Two model scales, multiple attack types, distribution comparison. Clear deliverable (scale-quality relationship) but the experimental setup spans jailbreaking at two scales plus automated quality evaluation.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
